title: Routines: the agent saves a chain of operations once, the app runs it on any card in one call
description: Fabio 2026-09-29. The agent saves a chain of operations (upscale -> face detail -> a style -> a Flow ...) as a routine file, project or global, through one short `routine` tool (list/save/run/delete); the RENDERER runs it: each card runs the chain, step 1 makes a new card, later steps are its History versions, N cards land as one new stack. Missing model/Flow = nothing runs; a paid step asks once. Plan: plan.md; decisions: brief.md; facts: research/findings.md.
